data.desc: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. (Nasdaq: EFSI) is the parent company of Bank of Clarke, a Virginia state-chartered bank established in 1881 and headquartered in Berryville, Virginia. Bank of Clarke serves customers from the Shenandoah Valley to Northern Virginia through 14 full-service branches, a drive-through facility and a loan production office in Rockville, Maryland, and offers community banking, wealth management, and mortgage and SBA banking services. As of June 30, 2026, Eagle Financial Services had total assets of $1.8 billion, total deposits of $1.6 billion and gross loans of $1.5 billion, and its wealth management business had approximately $599 million in assets under management.
